from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CaseType(BaseModel):
    """Each document classified with its case type and evidence."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title/identifier as provided, e.g. '《判决文书1》'")
    case_type: Literal['行政案件', '民事案件', '执行案件', '赔偿案件', '刑事案件'] = Field(description="The case type classification for this document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The formal type of document (e.g., 裁定书, 判决书, 通知书)")
    applicable_law: str | None = Field(description="The main law cited in the document")
    party_nature: str | None = Field(description="Nature of parties (e.g., 平等主体, 行政机关vs当事人)")
    evidence_quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseType]
